import pytest
from inventory.models import Item
from inventory.service import Inventory

def test_skus_are_normalized_and_updates_are_atomic():
    store = Inventory([Item(' ab-1 ', 2, 1)])
    assert store.adjust('AB-1', -1) == 1
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        store.adjust('AB-1', -2)
    assert store.adjust('AB-1', 0) == 1

def test_reorder_report_is_sorted_and_detached():
    store = Inventory([Item('b', 1, 1), Item('a', 0, 2), Item('c', 4, 1)])
    report = store.needs_reorder()
    assert [item.sku for item in report] == ['A', 'B']
    report[0].quantity = 99
    assert store.adjust('A', 0) == 0

import json
from jsonpipe.core import transform
from jsonpipe.cli import main

def test_transform_filters_sorts_and_counts_bad_lines():
    rows, bad = transform(['{"id":"b","score":3}', 'bad', '{"id":"a","score":7}', '{"id":"x"}'], 3)
    assert bad == 2
    assert rows == [{'id':'a','score':7}, {'id':'b','score':3}]

def test_cli_writes_jsonl_and_error_count(tmp_path, capsys):
    source = tmp_path / 'in.jsonl'
    errors = tmp_path / 'errors.txt'
    source.write_text('{"id":"b","score":2}\nnope\n{"id":"a","score":9}\n', encoding='utf-8')
    assert main([str(source), '--min-score', '2', '--errors', str(errors)]) == 0
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.splitlines() == ['{"id":"a","score":9}', '{"id":"b","score":2}']
    assert errors.read_text(encoding='utf-8') == '1\n'

setup_files.tests/test_manifest.py:
import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
from manifest import build_manifest

def test_manifest_is_sorted_excludes_output_and_is_stable(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path/'z.txt').write_text('z', encoding='utf-8')
    (tmp_path/'a').mkdir(); (tmp_path/'a'/'x.txt').write_text('x', encoding='utf-8')
    out=tmp_path/'manifest.json'
    result=build_manifest(tmp_path, out)
    expected=[{'path':'a/x.txt','sha256':hashlib.sha256(b'x').hexdigest(),'size':1},{'path':'z.txt','sha256':hashlib.sha256(b'z').hexdigest(),'size':1}]
    assert result == expected
    assert json.loads(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) == expected
    assert build_manifest(tmp_path, out) == expected
